test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) TX-RV 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/169030042e4aee822f25d9ed36e275d1f207b56ba4803c42dc70dec315706552.png] 

Option 2) SV-MP 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92577e3d922331ad26b3b776df3d2166138972ea7cb7b024669e89c78725dae0.png] 

Option 3) AD-UX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84e8a4f31f08a92e30fb24f7c3bbaa32603c8fd06dd6d31d3395ad189fef303f.png] 

Option 4) FI-ZC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccb3a1a94746ceac43d5b6cc35f3e8a98cdf2e19ec9bc8172fbc74212654ff29.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'TX-RV ' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
